name: dbt-heroes
description: A curated collection of Lightdash plugins for the dbt ecosystem, covering data analysis, semantic layer development, content administration, and organization management.

plugins.name: lightdash-analysis
plugins.description: Explore Lightdash data and generate insights from explores, charts, and dashboards.

plugins.name: lightdash-content-admin
plugins.description: Manage Lightdash spaces, charts, and dashboards with lineage analysis and validation.

plugins.name: lightdash-development
plugins.description: Build and maintain the Lightdash semantic layer with dbt 1.10+ metrics and dimensions.

plugins.name: lightdash-org-admin
plugins.description: Manage Lightdash organization users, groups, projects, and spaces.

plugins.name: lightdash-agentops
plugins.description: Build, manage, and tune AI agents for Lightdash workflows with eval-driven development.
